title: Man shot, killed by police after stabbing three people ; SIU probing death that followed assaults: [Ontario Edition]
article: The man began to stab his victim in the Cordukes St. driveway and a man and woman in their 70s who lived nearby tried to rescue her, police said.
One man is dead and three people are recovering from stab wounds after Ottawa police officers opened fire yesterday when a domestic assault spilled into the street.

Ottawa Region police said last night the man, identified by neighbours as Frank Hutterer, was assaulting a woman believed to be his girlfriend about 8:30 a.m. when the fight moved out to a neighbour's driveway in Stittsville, Ont., 20 kilometres south of Ottawa.
The man began to stab his victim in the Cordukes St. driveway and a man and woman in their 70s who lived nearby tried to rescue her, police said.
Neighbours said the elderly couple, whom they identified as Mitch and Marg Smith, were also stabbed.
Police, who can release little information because the province's special investigations unit is probing the incident, say they encountered an aggressor and shot him.
The SIU, a civilian agency, investigates all deaths and serious injuries involving police.
Kathrine McGregor, who has lived on the street for 34 years, said Hutterer has only been in the area about two years, and always kept to himself.
"We never heard anything bad about him," said McGregor, who wasn't home when the shooting happened. "It's a very quiet area. People get along with each other."
Police say injuries to the three stabbing victims aren't life threatening.
